t: You're looking at 55 Broadway, a Grade I listed office building near St James's Park. When it was finished, it was the tallest office block in London. It was designed by Charles Holden, who won the RIBA London Architecture Medal for it in 1931. It was built as headquarters of the Underground Electric Railways Company of London, and Holden is best known for designing many Underground stations in the 1920s and 1930s. In 2020 it was announced that the building would become a luxury hotel.
